---
title: "MLS Match Scoring Before and After Messi"
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r}
#| fig-width: 10
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)

mls <- read_csv("data/mls_modern.csv") %>%
  mutate(Date = dmy(Date)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(HG) & !is.na(AG)) %>%
  mutate(
    total_goals = HG + AG,
    group = case_when(
      Date < as.Date("2023-07-21") ~ "Pre-Messi Era (2012–July 2023)",
      Date >= as.Date("2023-07-21") &
        Home != "Inter Miami" & Away != "Inter Miami" ~
        "Messi Era: Other MLS Matches",
      Date >= as.Date("2023-07-21") &
        (Home == "Inter Miami" | Away == "Inter Miami") ~
        "Messi Era: Inter Miami Matches"
    )
  )

goals_by_period <- mls %>%
  mutate(period = if_else(Date < as.Date("2023-07-21"), "before", "after")) %>%
  group_by(period) %>%
  summarise(average = mean(total_goals), .groups = "drop")

inter_miami_record <- mls %>%
  filter(group == "Messi Era: Inter Miami Matches") %>%
  summarise(
    matches = n(),
    wins = sum(
      (Home == "Inter Miami" & HG > AG) |
        (Away == "Inter Miami" & AG > HG)
    ),
    draws = sum(HG == AG),
    losses = sum(
      (Home == "Inter Miami" & HG < AG) |
        (Away == "Inter Miami" & AG < HG)
    ),
    goals_for = mean(if_else(Home == "Inter Miami", HG, AG)),
    goals_against = mean(if_else(Home == "Inter Miami", AG, HG))
  )

ggplot(mls, aes(x = Date, y = total_goals)) +
  geom_jitter(
    aes(color = group),
    alpha = 0.35,
    height = 0.25,
    size = 1.4
  ) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", color = "black", se = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Pre-Messi Era (2012–July 2023)" = "#5c768d",
      "Messi Era: Other MLS Matches" = "#1f4e78",
      "Messi Era: Inter Miami Matches" = "#e63973"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Total Goals per MLS Match (2012–2026)",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "n = ", scales::comma(nrow(mls)),
      " real MLS matches; Inter Miami highlighted since Messi's July 2023 debut"
    ),
    x = "Match Date",
    y = "Total Goals Scored",
    color = "Match Category",
    caption = "Source: Football-Data.co.uk Official MLS Match Records"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

Matches averaged `r sprintf("%.2f", goals_by_period$average[goals_by_period$period == "before"])` goals before July 21, 2023, and `r sprintf("%.2f", goals_by_period$average[goals_by_period$period == "after"])` afterward. Since that date, Inter Miami recorded `r inter_miami_record$wins` wins, `r inter_miami_record$draws` draws, and `r inter_miami_record$losses` losses in `r inter_miami_record$matches` matches, averaging `r sprintf("%.2f", inter_miami_record$goals_for)` goals scored and `r sprintf("%.2f", inter_miami_record$goals_against)` conceded per match.
